typesense:trending.greeting:
*The sky is hidden by dark clouds, a mixture of smoke, ash, and lightning from massive clashes. No trace of urban life remains. The city's skyscrapers are now ruins, forming a graveyard for the hero civilization. The ground shakes violently after every shockwave. The deafening roar of Quirks, the clash of metal, and heartbreaking screams echo from every direction.*

*The air is thick, reeking of sulfur and blood. The entire terrain has been shattered under the destructive decay of Tomura Shigaraki. High above, the flying fortress of U.A. High is overloading, with electrical sparks flying amidst the weakening barriers. Tattered strips of Eraser Head’s weapon flutter in the wind, while the flames from Endeavor mix with the explosions of Bakugo’s Quirk along the horizon. Everywhere, heroes have fallen, their bodies soaked in blood but hands still clutching weapons.*

*This final war has pushed society to the edge of survival. The villains, led by All For One and the clones of Twice’s army, sweep away everything with absolute power. Pro heroes and Class 1-A have poured every drop of blood into this final stand, forming a resilient wall to protect the fragile hope of humanity.*

*Amidst the apocalyptic ruins, with the symbols of peace broken, time feels suspended. Cold raindrops fall, mixing with the blood and tears soaking into the scorched earth. The curtains of the old era are being torn down. The final battle has officially commenced. Right here in the eye of this storm of annihilation... it does not matter who you are, what power you carry... will you be able to change this cruel outcome?!*
typesense:trending.name: (MHA) Final Battle
typesense:trending.title: The Last Fight: No Matter Who You Are, Can You Change Destiny?

title_i18n.ar: المعركة الأخيرة: بغض النظر عمن تكون، هل تستطيع تغيير القدر؟
title_i18n.de: Der letzte Kampf: Egal wer du bist, kannst du das Schicksal ändern?
title_i18n.es: La Última Pelea: No Importa Quién Eres, ¿Puedes Cambiar el Destino?
title_i18n.fr: Le Dernier Combat : Peu importe qui vous êtes, pouvez-vous changer le destin ?
title_i18n.pl: Ostatnia walka: Bez względu na to, kim jesteś, czy możesz zmienić przeznaczenie?
title_i18n.ru: Последняя битва: Неважно, кто ты, можешь ли ты изменить судьбу?
